name: gpt-imagegen
description: Generate raster images through ChatGPT/Codex OAuth or OmniRoute, with reference images and non-overwriting PNG output.

omniroute_base_url.title: OmniRoute base URL
omniroute_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible OmniRoute endpoint used when ChatGPT OAuth is missing or expired, e.g. https://omniroute.example.com/v1. Leave empty to use OpenCode's OmniRoute config or http://localhost:20128/v1.

omniroute_api_key.title: OmniRoute API key
omniroute_api_key.description: API key for the OmniRoute endpoint. Leave empty to use the key stored in OpenCode.
